title: 第七章 天心剑法
content_zh:
张若尘倒也没有什么情绪波动，淡淡的道： “那就恭喜表妹，今后我们也算得上是亲上加亲了。”
说完这话，张若尘便转身离开。
第一次见面，张若尘对这一位美貌动人的表妹没有什么好感，话不投机半句多，所以他便有些索然无味的离开。
见到张若尘竟然一点反应都没有，林家的那些年轻武者全部都大失所望。
怎么会这样？
看到张若尘无所谓的样子，林泞姗的心头也有几分失落，盯着张若尘转身离去的背影，有些不甘心的道： “你难道不想知道原因吗？”
林泞姗与谁订婚，张若尘是真的一点兴趣都没有，不过她既然非要告诉他的样子，他自然便勉为其难的停下脚步，轻轻的点了点头： “你们订婚的时候，我一定会到场祝贺。若是没有别的事，我就去找娘亲了。”
刚刚说完这话，张若尘便看见林妃从林府内院走了出来。
林妃的双眼有些发红，显然是刚刚哭过，虽然已经将眼泪擦干，但是又怎么瞒得过张若尘？
张若尘立即迎上去，关切的问道， “娘亲，你怎么了？谁欺负你了？”
林妃摇了摇头，道： “没事，我们回去吧！”
看林妃的样子，怎么可能没事？
见过林泞姗之后，张若尘对林家人便没有一点好感。
看到林妃此刻的样子，张若尘对林家就更加没有好感了。
“慢着！”
林奉先背着双手，从内院走了出来，淡淡的向着张若尘看了一眼，从衣袖中取出一卷兽皮古书，道： “这是一套人级下品的修炼功法‘太阿决"，可以开辟出七条经脉，拿去修炼吧！虽然不算是什么高深的修炼功法，至少可以完成洗髓冲脉，对你来说，应该是够用了。”
随后，林奉先又命人取来两份洗髓液，冷峭的道： “你的身上毕竟也有我们林家的血脉，这两份洗髓液也一并拿去！”
林妃深深的盯了林奉先一眼，露出一个感激的眼神，立即拉着张若尘的手，道： “尘儿，还不快谢谢舅舅。”
张若尘看着林奉先那一副施舍的样子，心中便十分不悦，难怪娘亲会两眼通红，估计刚才娘亲为了向他求一卷修炼功法，在他的面前没少受屈辱。
“不用他们林家人施舍，娘亲我们走！”

张若尘看也不看林奉先拿出的修炼功法和洗髓液，拉着林妃便离开林府。
“给脸不要脸，还真将自己当成了王子。”林家的那些年轻武者全部都噗之以鼻，冷笑不已。
林泞姗盯着那一个毅然走出林府的少年，心中更加诧异，总感觉那一位从小软弱的表哥似乎变得有些不一样了。
“开启了神武印记，他自然会变得硬气一些。但是，他却不知道十六岁才开启神武印记，其实早已过了修武的黄金年龄。想那么多干什么，今后我们注定将是两个世界的人。”
林泞姗叹了一声，重新返回演武场，继续修炼起来。
出了林府，林妃道： “尘儿，你太冲动了。只要你能成为武者，能够用武道强身健体，娘亲就算受再多的委屈也无妨。”
张若尘的身体站得笔直，转过身盯着印着 “林府”的金色匾额，斩金截铁的道： “娘亲，你放心吧！就算没有林家的施舍，我也依旧能够成为武者，而且还要是武者中的强者。”
林妃轻声的一叹，不再继续说下去，忽然又像是想到了什么，道： “尘儿，泞姗和七王子就要订婚的事，你已经知道了吧？你可千万不要太伤心！”
张若尘笑了笑道： “娘亲，你就放心吧！天下的好女子多得是，比林泞姗好的女子，总还是有
“你能这么想，娘亲就真的放心了。”林妃欣慰的笑道。
回到云武王宫，张若尘将最后一枚血丹服下，进入时空晶石的内空间，再次开始修炼龙象般若拳。
炼到精疲力竭之后，他才坐下来短暂的休息。
“娘亲在林家受到的屈辱，我迟早要让林家加倍的还回来。三年前，到底发生了什么事？看来得找机会向云儿姐姐询问一番，当然我现在的首要目标是尽快冲击到黄极境中期。”
想要冲击黄极境中期，就必须要服用洗髓液。
一份洗髓液的价格，需要花费至少两百枚银币才能买到。
两百枚银币，对张若尘可不是小数目。
而且，他修炼的是《九天明帝经》，想要突破黄极境中期，一份洗髓液显然是不够。
“有了！”
张若尘一拍额头，暗骂自己太蠢，明明自己拥有一座巨大的宝库，却还整天为赚取银币费神。
要知道，他的上一世可是明帝之子，翻阅过很多高品级的功法和武技，全部都记在脑海中，随便拿出一本修炼功法和修炼武技也能卖出天价。

《九天明帝经》和龙象般若拳在整个昆仑界都是神功宝典级别的东西，自然不可能拿出来贩卖。
他的记忆中，还有别的一些低品级的功法和武技，随便拿出一本，在云武郡国也能造成不小的轰动。
张若尘立即找来纸张和笔墨，将一套灵级武技 “天心剑法”默写下来。
天心剑法，已经是张若尘记忆中品级最低的武技。
灵级下品。
“灵级下品的武技，在云武郡国应该算得上是顶尖武技了，就算是林家那种大家族，最强大的武技，估计也就是灵级下品，而且最多只有一两套，做为镇族的绝学。”
要知道，在云武郡国，很多武者是没有机会修炼武技。就算是人级下品的武技，对他们来说也是了不起的宝物。
价格最低的人级下品的武技，至少也要卖三百枚银币，其中一些厉害的人级下品的武技，甚至能够卖到一千枚银币以上，普通的武道散修根本买不起。一些武者为争夺一本人级下品的武技，甚至不惜与人拼命。
至于灵级下品的武技，一旦拿出去卖，就算是那些大家族的家主也会心动不已，不惜一切代价也要将武技买回去。
多一本灵级武技，家族的底蕴就会增加一大截。
将天心剑法的修炼方式写完，张若尘又在纸张上面画出每一招剑法的小图。
张若尘将体内为数不多的真气，全部凝聚到笔尖，将真气和武道意境，全部凝画到剑招图式之中。
将体内的真气耗尽，也仅仅只是画完一幅图。
张若尘立即盘坐起来，运转《九天明帝经》，将气池中的真气修炼满，便开始画第二幅图。
整整花费半天时间，才将 “天心剑法”的十二招图式全部画完。
他的修为虽然已经不在，但是眼力却还在，对武道的理解也还在，画出的每一招剑法都十分精妙，与 “天心剑法”的最初本上面画出的剑招没有什么区别。
“以我现在对武道的理解，画出灵级下品的武技，已经是极限。若是要我画灵级中品的武技图录，估计就只能画出灵级中品的武技的三分之一意境。”
武技秘籍，不是随随便便就能拓印和复制。
普通人就算将 “天心剑诀”的口诀和剑招图式默写下来，那也只是徒有其形，就算将剑法修炼成功，也根本不可能达到灵级下品剑法的威力。
张若尘上一世是天极境大圆满的强者，也仅仅只能画出灵级下品的剑法的神韵，再高

级别的武技，他就画不出全部神韵了。
“灵级下品的剑法，应该能够卖出一个不错的价格。”
张若尘并没有立即就带着 “天心剑法”去武市，而是等到了天黑，才向着宫门的方向行去。
“九王子殿下，这么晚还要出宫？”守卫宫门的两位禁卫说道。
两位禁卫也知道九王子和林妃被赶去了偏殿居住，也就意味着他们在王宫里面失势了。所以他们的脸上并没有恭敬的神色，甚至都没有对张若尘行礼。
张若尘并不是曾经的那个懦弱的张若尘，目光锐利的盯了那两位禁卫一眼，微微挺起胸膛，道： “本王子要去林府找泞姗表妹，还不立即
张若尘毕竟是王孙贵胄，两位禁卫自然不会真的得罪他，他们将宫门
“硬气什么？若他不是云武郡王之子，早就已经不知死了多少次。”其中一位禁卫冷啐了一句。
“据说林家的那一位天才女子林泞姗就要和七王子订婚了，他居然还不死心，真是够愚蠢。”另一位禁卫不屑的说道。
张若尘自然不是真的去找林泞姗，只是找这样一个借口出宫而不被人怀疑。
走出王宫，张若尘便从时空晶石里面取出一件宽大的黑色斗篷衣，将整个身体都裹在斗篷衣里面，走进了灯火通明的王城。
黑暗中，根本没有人能够看清他的脸。..
没过多久，张若尘便穿过一条条繁华的街道，走进武市。
王城别的那些地方，只能算是 “俗市”。 “武市”所占的区域，只有整个王城的十分之一大小，却是云武郡城最繁盛的地方。
武市又分区域：丹市、器市、兽市、奴市、中心拍卖场。
武市在一定程度上决定着整个云武郡国的兴衰，所以，郡国对武市的管理十分严格。
每一个进入武市的入口都有军士在把手，只有武者，或者身份高贵的人，才有资格进入武市。

content_en:
Zhang Ruochen didn't have any mood swings at all, and said calmly: "Congratulations to my cousin, we can be considered as kissing each other from now on."
After saying this, Zhang Ruochen turned and left.
When they met for the first time, Zhang Ruochen didn't have a good impression of this beautiful cousin and didn't talk much about it, so he left in a dull mood.
Seeing that Zhang Ruochen didn't react at all, the young warriors of the Lin family were all disappointed.
how so?
Seeing Zhang Ruochen's indifferent look, Lin Nianshan felt a little disappointed. Staring at Zhang Ruochen's back as he turned away, she said with some reluctance: "Don't you want to know the reason?"
Zhang Ruochen really had no interest in who Lin Cianshan was engaged to, but since she insisted on telling him, he reluctantly stopped and nodded gently: "When you get engaged, I will definitely be there to congratulate you. If there is nothing else, I will go to find my mother."
Just after saying this, Zhang Ruochen saw Concubine Lin walking out of the inner courtyard of Lin Mansion.
Concubine Lin's eyes were a little red. She had obviously cried just now. Although she had wiped her tears away, how could she hide it from Zhang Ruochen?
Zhang Ruochen immediately stepped forward and asked with concern, "Mom, what's wrong with you? Who bullied you?"
Concubine Lin shook her head and said, "It's okay, let's go back!"
Looking at Concubine Lin's appearance, how could she be fine?
After meeting Lin Nishan, Zhang Ruochen had no good impression of the Lin family.
Seeing Concubine Lin's appearance at this moment, Zhang Ruochen became even less fond of the Lin family.
"Wait!"
Lin Fengxian walked out of the inner courtyard with his hands behind his back. He glanced at Zhang Ruochen indifferently, took out an ancient animal skin book from his sleeve and said, "This is a set of low-level human-level training techniques called 'Tai Ah Jue'. It can open up seven meridians, take it and practice it!" Although it is not a profound cultivation technique, it can at least complete the process of cleansing the marrow and flushing the meridians, which should be enough for you. "
Later, Lin Fengxian ordered someone to get two more marrow cleansing solutions, and said coldly: "After all, you also have the blood of our Lin family, so take these two copies of the marrow cleansing solutions too! "
Concubine Lin stared deeply at Lin Fengxian, showed a grateful look, and immediately took Zhang Ruochen's hand and said: "Chen'er, thank you uncle quickly. "
Zhang Ruochen felt very unhappy when he saw Lin Fengxian's alms-giving look. No wonder his mother's eyes were red. She must have been humiliated in front of him in order to ask him for a volume of practice skills.
"No need for charity from the Lin family, mother, let's go! "
Zhang Ruochen didn't even look at the cultivation techniques and marrow cleansing liquid that Lin Fengxian took out, and pulled Concubine Lin away from the Lin Mansion.
"You are so shameless, you really think of yourself as a prince. "All the young warriors from the Lin family snorted and sneered.
Lin Ningshan stared at the young man who resolutely walked out of the Lin Mansion, feeling even more surprised. She always felt that her cousin who had been weak since childhood seemed to be a little different.
“With the Mark of Divine Martial Arts turned on, he will naturally become tougher. However, he didn't know that he only opened the mark of divine martial arts at the age of sixteen, which was actually long past the golden age for practicing martial arts. Why do you think so much? From now on we are destined to be people in two worlds. "
Lin Ningshan sighed, returned to the martial arts field, and continued to practice.
After leaving the Lin Mansion, Concubine Lin said: "Chen'er, you are too impulsive. As long as you can become a warrior and use martial arts to strengthen your body, it won't matter no matter how many grievances your mother suffers. "
Zhang Ruochen stood upright, turned around and stared at the golden plaque with "Lin Mansion" printed on it, and said decisively: "Mother, don't worry! Even without the charity of the Lin family, I would still be able to become a warrior, and I would still be a strong one among warriors. "
Concubine Lin sighed softly and stopped talking. Suddenly she thought of something and said:"Chen'er, you already know that Ningshan and the Seventh Prince are getting engaged, right? Don't be too sad!"
Zhang Ruochen smiled and said, "Mom, don't worry! There are many good women in the world, and there are still some who are better than Lin Nishan."
"If you think so, my mother will be really relieved. Concubine Lin smiled happily.
Returning to Yunwu Palace, Zhang Ruochen took the last blood pill, entered the inner space of the space-time crystal, and began to practice Dragon Elephant Prajna Fist again.
After exercising until he was exhausted, he sat down and took a short rest.
"Sooner or later, I will make the Lin family pay back double the humiliation my mother suffered at the Lin family. What happened three years ago? It seems that I have to find an opportunity to ask sister Yun'er. Of course, my first goal now is to reach the middle stage of Huangji Realm as soon as possible. "
If you want to hit the middle stage of Huangji Realm, you must take marrow cleansing liquid.
The price of a marrow cleansing solution requires at least two hundred silver coins to buy.
Two hundred silver coins is not a small amount for Zhang Ruochen.
Moreover, he was practicing the "Nine Heavens Ming Emperor Sutra", and if he wanted to break through to the middle stage of the Huangji Realm, one marrow cleansing solution was obviously not enough.
"Yes! "
Zhang Ruochen slapped his forehead and cursed himself for being too stupid. He obviously owned a huge treasure house, but he still spent all day trying to earn silver coins.
You must know that in his previous life, he was the son of Emperor Ming. He had read through many high-level exercises and martial arts and memorized them all in his mind. He could easily sell a copy of the exercises and martial arts for a sky-high price.
The "Nine Heavens Ming Emperor Sutra" and the Dragon-Elephant Prajna Fist are items of magical power in the entire Kunlun world, so naturally they cannot be sold.
There are other low-level exercises and martial arts in his memory. Taking out one at random can cause quite a sensation in Yunwu County.
Zhang Ruochen immediately found paper and pen and ink, and silently wrote down a set of spiritual-level martial arts "Tianxin Sword Technique".
Tianxin Sword Technique is already the lowest level of martial arts in Zhang Ruochen's memory.
Low grade spiritual level.
"Low-level spiritual martial arts should be considered top-notch martial arts in Yunwu County. Even for a big family like the Lin family, the most powerful martial arts are probably low-level spiritual skills, and there are only one or two sets at most, which are the unique skills of the town clan. "
You know, in Yunwu County, many warriors do not have the opportunity to practice martial arts. Even low-level human-level martial arts are still great treasures to them.
The lowest-priced low-level human-level martial arts skills cost at least three hundred silver coins. Some of the most powerful low-level human-level martial arts skills can even be sold for more than a thousand silver coins. Ordinary martial arts cultivators simply cannot afford them. Some warriors would even fight to the death for a low-level human-level martial skill.
As for the low-level spiritual martial arts, once they are sold, even the heads of those big families will be very excited and will buy back the martial arts at all costs.
With one more spiritual-level martial arts, the family's heritage will be greatly increased.
After finishing writing the training methods of Tianxin Sword Technique, Zhang Ruochen drew small pictures of each sword technique on the paper.
Zhang Ruochen condensed all the few true energy in his body into the tip of his pen, and condensed all the true energy and martial arts artistic conception into the sword move pattern.
Even if you exhaust all the energy in your body, you can only finish painting a picture.
Zhang Ruochen immediately sat up cross-legged, circulated the "Nine Heavens Ming Emperor Sutra", cultivated the true energy in the qi pool, and then began to draw the second picture.
It took half a day to draw all the twelve moves of "Tianxin Sword Technique".
Although his cultivation is gone, his eyesight is still there, and his understanding of martial arts is still there. Every sword move he draws is very exquisite, and is no different from the sword moves drawn in the original book of "Tianxin Sword Technique".
"Based on my current understanding of martial arts, it is already the limit to draw low-level spiritual martial arts. If I were asked to draw a catalog of martial arts for mid-level spiritual level, I would probably only be able to draw mid-level spiritual level ones.One-third of the artistic conception of martial arts. "
Martial arts secrets cannot be printed and copied casually.
Even if an ordinary person writes down the formulas and sword moves of "Tianxin Sword Technique", it will only be in vain. Even if he successfully cultivates the sword technique, it is impossible to reach the power of the low-level spiritual sword technique.
Zhang Ruochen was a strong man in the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Realm in his previous life, and he could only draw the charm of low-grade swordsmanship at the spiritual level. No matter how high he was,
He couldn't draw the full charm of martial arts at this level.
“Low-level spiritual swordsmanship should be able to sell for a good price. "
Zhang Ruochen did not take the "Tianxin Sword Technique" to the martial arts market immediately, but waited until dark before heading towards the palace gate.
"His Royal Highness the Ninth Prince, are you leaving the palace so late? " said the two guards guarding the palace gate.
The two imperial guards also knew that the Ninth Prince and Concubine Lin had been driven to live in the side hall, which meant that they had lost power in the palace. So there was no respectful look on their faces, and they didn't even salute Zhang Ruochen.
Zhang Ruochen was no longer the cowardly Zhang Ruochen he once was. He glanced sharply at the two guards, puffed up his chest slightly, and said: "This prince is going to the Lin Mansion to find cousin Ningshan. Why don't you do it right away?"
After all, Zhang Ruochen is a nobleman, so the two guards will not really offend him.
"Why are you so stubborn? If he hadn't been the son of Prince Yunwu, he would have died countless times." One of the guards spat coldly.
"It is said that Lin Ningshan, a talented woman from the Lin family, is going to be engaged to the seventh prince. He still doesn't give up. He is really stupid." Another guard said disdainfully.
Of course, Zhang Ruochen didn't really go to Lin Nershan, he just found an excuse to leave the palace without being suspected.
After walking out of the palace, Zhang Ruochen took out a large black cloak from the space-time crystal, wrapped his entire body in the cloak, and walked into the brightly lit royal city.
In the darkness, no one could see his face clearly. ..
Not long after, Zhang Ruochen walked through the bustling streets and walked into Wu City.
The other places in the royal city can only be regarded as "common markets". The area occupied by "Wu City" is only one-tenth the size of the entire royal city, but it is the most prosperous place in Yunwu County.
Wu City is divided into regions: Dan City, Equipment Market, Beast Market, Slave City, and Central Auction House.
Wu City determines the rise and fall of the entire Yunwu County to a certain extent, so the county has very strict management of Wu City.
Every entrance into Wu City is handled by a sergeant. Only warriors, or people with noble status, are qualified to enter Wu City.
